rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial noun for a deceitful trick or ploy.

example.english: I saw through his deceit at once.
example.traditional: 佢嗰啲花招，我一眼就睇穿喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go2 di1 faa1 ziu1 ngo5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 cyun1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the deceit is a scam or a setup intended to trick someone.

example.english: This phone scam is a deceit aimed at tricking elderly people.
example.traditional: 呢個電話騙局專呃老人家。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 din6 waa2 pin3 guk6 zyun1 ngaak1 lou5 jan4 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for deceit as an abstract act or practice, especially in formal or official contexts.

example.english: The company will pursue the matter if there is any deceit in the contract.
example.traditional: 合約入面如有任何欺詐行為，公司會追究到底。
example.jyutping: hap6 joek3 jap6 min6 jyu4 jau5 jam6 ho4 hei1 zaa3 hang4 wai4 gung1 si1 wui6 zeoi1 gau3 dou3 dai2
